description: Upload a prerun script or file to LambdaTest. Prerun files execute before the test starts on the remote machine.

filePath.description: Absolute local path to the pre-run file to upload

name.description: Optional upload name. Defaults to the pre-run filename without extension.

postRunFilePath.description: Optional absolute local path to a post-run file. If omitted, the same file will be used.

name: uploadPrerunFile
title: Upload Prerun File
